531501.name: Unknown Missiles
531501.description: Fires a barrage of unknown objects, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

531502.name: Unknown Shield
531502.description:
Generates a barrier in front of it, defending against Nikkes' attacks.
While the barrier is up, it greatly decreases the damage taken.

531503.name: High-Power Beam
531503.description: Fires a high-power beam at a single Nikke, dealing massive damage.

531504.name: Unknown Shock Wave
531504.description: Generates a code barrier and emits a shock wave, dealing damage to all Nikkes. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.

531505.name: Unknown Splitting Missiles
531505.description: Fires a barrage of unknown objects, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

531507.name: Unknown Light Beam
531507.description: Emits an unknown light beam. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals massive damage to all Nikkes.

531509.name: Unknown Projectiles
531509.description:
Fires unknown projectiles, dealing damage to multiple Nikkes.
The unknown projectiles can be intercepted.

531513.name: Unknown Splitting Objects
531513.description: Fires unknown objects randomly, dealing massive damage to all Nikkes.
